$comment: What Roswaal is built from or written for, and the release of each last looked at. The Upkeep workflow's release watch opens an issue when one is newer; once it has been dealt with, raise `seen` here.

luau.why: The language Roswaal writes and reads. New syntax needs the parser (src/core/luau) and the emitter, as if local did.

lune.why: The Lune catalogue is built from this tag: LUNE_VERSION in scripts/build-lune.mjs.

stylua.why: Formats the Luau Roswaal writes, when installed. A release can format syntax the last could not.

rojo.why: The project file format node maps compile to.

wally.why: The registry Add from Wally asks, as Wally-Version 0.3.2 (src/server/wally.ts).

material-symbols.why: Class icons are built from this version: MATERIAL in scripts/build-class-icons.mjs.
